newsitem.title: DENMARK: FLS unit buys French engineering firm.
newsitem.headline: FLS unit buys French engineering firm.

text.p: Danish cement and engineering group FLS Industries A/S said on Wednesday its RM Industrial group subsidiary's French Besson & Bois S.A. unit signed an agreement to acquire the sheet and plate perforation activities of Krieg & Zivy Industries.

Following the acquisition, Krieg & Zivy Industries is to be merged with Lyon-based Bresson & Bois, which has annual 60 million franc turnover, and a new sales and distribution organisation is to be set up in the Paris region, FLS said.
It said the deal, valued at some 30 million francs, would further consolidate the company's expansion on the French market. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
